notes.title: 🎮 Devlog: Designing the Invisible
notes.content:
[p]From the very beginning, we knew [i]Enigma of Fear[/i] wasn’t just about combat. We aimed to build a deep investigative experience, one where players piece together clues, uncover secrets, and solve puzzles. The challenge? Investigative level design is invisible,  it lives inside the player’s mind.[/p][p][/p][p]That’s where [b]evidence[/b] came in: interactive objects and documents that reveal fragments of the story and point to puzzle solutions. Each one had to carry narrative weight, emotional meaning, and gameplay logic. Designing them was like building a puzzle where nothing could be too obvious.[/p][p]Our first playtest? A solo tabletop-style RPG! Using a layered house map and live narration, we tested how players interpreted clues and navigated the mystery. That’s how our first investigative cycle was born.[/p][p][/p][p]🎉 The most unforgettable moment? Two players solving the first major puzzle together during a final playtest, their excitement was electric. For our team, it was proof that all those years of effort had paid off. 💜[/p][p][/p][p]Got a similar story to share? Join us on Discord and tell us about your favorite “Aha!” moment: \[[url="https://discord.gg/Rd8m5VbU"]https://discord.gg/Rd8m5VbU[/url]][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Development Updates + Special BRIndies Sale!
notes.content:
[b]Hello, paranormal detectives![/b]

We’ve got some exciting updates about Enigma of Fear to share with you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544928/d59548345edd414816b49c84f591edffc8a3a7bf.png[/img]

[h3][b]Enigma is coming to consoles![/b][/h3]
 Since the game’s release, we’ve been working hard on bringing Enigma of Fear to consoles! We’re currently in the testing and content adjustment phase for the new hardware. The development kits are in our hands, and things are moving full speed ahead. Soon, Mia will be able to visit The Place That Doesn’t Exist on major consoles too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544928/2bb9f630590d77eaecedc02ea3ae4bb79030562f.png[/img]

[h3][b]First DLC already in development![/b][/h3]
 We’re thrilled to announce that the first DLC for Enigma of Fear is already in development. Our crowdfunding backers will get some sneak peeks at screens and ideas we’re working on leading up to launch, but we’ll also be posting a few updates here for everyone!

The return to the perimeter will include a new area, lots of new puzzles, and a brand-new enigma, expanding the game’s main storyline and introducing new characters and story arcs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544928/d544437bab1ef7e11ea7b3d998936572148d9fd2.png[/img]

[h3][b]And to celebrate the success of Enigma of Fear...[/b][/h3]
We’re part of the very first BRIndies bundle, alongside some of Brazil’s most successful indie game hits. The bundle includes 5 amazing titles that made a splash both in Brazil and worldwide:
[list][*] Atomic Picnic
[*] Enigma do Medo
[*] Pocket Bravery
[*] Mullet Madjack
[*] Soulstone Survivors [/list]

The bundle is now available exclusively on Steam and Nuuvem for a limited time. Grab it while you can!

📅 Check out the bundle page here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53119/]https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53119/[/url]

notes.title: Enigma of Fear is out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544928/f46503d4fc517662194aa28c2afa42ac2d21fadb.png[/img]

[b]Hey detectives,[/b]

After a long journey, the moment is finally here.
[h1][b]Enigma of Fear is out now for everyone.[/b][/h1]

We have poured our heart and souls into this project and now it’s time for you to fully enjoy it. All the effort and dedication from Enigma of Fear’s team can be found in every detail of the narrative, art, music and, of course, in the enigmas.

A story that we’re deeply proud of, and that it’s finally waiting for you.

Play the way that you want: analyze every detail of a profound narrative, make notes, solve the puzzles, fight paranormal creatures or try to pass through them quietly.

[previewyoutube=cRqywIJpO6Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Share your experience in Enigma of Fear and use the hashtag #enigmaoffear
We also invite you to join our [url=discord.gg/dumativa]Dumativa Discord[/url] to talk with the developers and [url=discord.gg/cellbit]Cellbit’s Discord[/url] to be part of the best detective community in the world.

We will forever be grateful for all your support that led us to this moment. For making this dream come true, from the bottom of our hearts: thank you!

You are part of this story. Without you it wouldn’t exist.

Waiting for you at the Perimeter,
Dumativa & Cellbit

notes.title: See you on November 28th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544928/930482b65c9e4d13f5991a1d9a937d7d833041f7.png[/img]

[b]Hey detectives,[/b]

We want to give a heartfelt thank you to everyone who played Enigma of Fear’s demo during the Screamfest Festival!

We had over 110k downloads during the Screamfest Festival, and more than 215k people already added Enigma of Fear to their wishlist on Steam. It was really amazing to see you all playing and reacting positively for both the demo and the Teaser.

In that time, we’ve received and read carefully countless feedback throughout our socials, and we’re working tirelessly in this final stage of development so you can have the best possible experience to investigate every mystery in the game.

If you have played Enigma of Fear’s demo on video or on stream, share it and tag us! Whether it is on Discord or on social media. We also invite you to join [url=https://discord.gg/cellbit]Cellbit’s Discord[/url] to meet fellow detectives and talk about your experience in the game and theories, as well as [url=discord.gg/dumativa]Dumativa’s Discord[/url] to talk directly with the developers.

The day is near. We’re very excited to show you the full game.
See you on November 28th.

Waiting for you at the Perimeter,
Dumativa & Cellbit

notes.title: Welcome to the Perimeter
notes.content:
Hey detectives,

If you’re reading this, it means you’re going to a place that doesn’t exist.

We’re thrilled to announce that Enigma of Fear will be released on [b]November 28th[/b] on Steam! Mark your calendar, set up the clock alarm and get your notepad ready to investigate a profound narrative filled with puzzles and a paranormal atmosphere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544928/d79217b2f3f27e8944b275b093c6f4e808f22511.gif[/img]

We also released a [b]new teaser[/b] with never seen scenes and you can watch it below:

[previewyoutube=Dtqm-m33KYo;full][/previewyoutube]

And for those who want to start the investigations right away, good news! We’re featured in the Halloween Festival and E[b]nigma of Fear’s demo is available NOW[/b] until November 4th. Make sure you join our [url=discord.gg/dumativa]Dumativa Discord[/url] to share your thoughts, talk with the devs and connect with fellow detectives, and [url=https://discord.gg/cellbit]Cellbit's Discord[/url] to also engage with the game’s community.

Thank you for your support so far and we can’t wait for you to explore and unravel the mysteries in Enigma of Fear.
You are the only one who can do this.

Waiting for you at the Perimeter,
Dumativa
